payload.title: Climate Reconstruction Workflow
payload.description: This workflow sets up a climate reconstruction job using the cfr.ReconJob class. It involves loading proxy data from a netCDF file, calculating climate anomalies, and specifying the Proxy System Model (PSM) and seasonality for proxies.
